name: stress-ng eigen
description: Start N workers that exercise the Eigen C++ matrix library for 2D matrix addition, multiplication, determinant, inverse and transpose operations on long double, double and float matrices. This currently is only available for gcc/g++ builds. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.duration: Duration (seconds) of the benchmarking framework run that produced this score, shared by all benchmarks and configs of that run.
